title: load_private_key_from_bytes has no test
description: crates/tls/src/lib.rs: load_private_key_from_bytes and load_tls_server_config_with_key_bytes were added as new public API but have no tests. These functions are called in three production paths (smtp, reader, transit TLS key loading via secretx). Needs: a test with a known PEM key bytes that succeeds, and a test with invalid/empty bytes that returns the correct error.
